items.title: “Neurological De-Armoring is underpinning (not redecorating) …”
items.where: Psychology is the Software; Biology is the Hardware., P7
items.your_version: Neurological De-Armoring is about fixing the underpinnings, not redecorating. It's a protocol that serves as a metabolic solvent, via HDAC inhibiton, that softens the "concrete" in the brainstem by using Glutamate modulation and supplementing Ketones (BHB) to allow us to dig under the house, and pour a new foundation, so we can eventually update the psychological software upstairs.

items.title: “Trial: UMP 150–300 mg in the morning with food for 3–7 days …”
items.where: Dopamine Receptor Burnout / DAWS Pattern: Uridine Monophosphate, P4
items.your_version: Do a trial with 150-300mg Uridine, in the morning with food. It shouldn't take more than 3 to 7 days to get an idea of whether or not it's beneficial. Keep your Omega-3's up, especially DHA and EPA. Make sure you have sufficient Choline - from eggs, Phosphatidylcholine, CDP-choline, etc, whichever works best for you. Don't start the uridine at the same time as starting some other major variable (like 5-HTP, Agmatine, D-serine, Keto diet, Iboga, Shrooms, LSD, Ketamine, etc), since the point is to see whether uridine itself changes the signal.
items.my_version: Trial: UMP 150–300 mg in the morning with food for 3–7 days. Keep omega-3s in place, especially DHA/EPA. Make sure there is enough choline from eggs, phosphatidylcholine, CDP-choline, or another tolerated choline source. Do not start UMP on the same day you start 5-HTP, agmatine, D-serine, keto, iboga, shrooms, LSD, ketamine, or any other major variable. You are trying to see whether UMP itself changes the signal.

items.title: “Do not combine agmatine casually with opioids, kratom, …”
items.where: A Complete Guide to Bio-De-Armoring, P9
items.your_version: Precautions/Side Effects: Do not use concurrently with opioids and/or kratom (will reduce tolerance), clonidine and/or guafacine, blood pressure lowering medications, nitrates, PDE-5 inhibitors, MAOIs, or other complex “psych” stacks without having a physician competent to consider the likelihoods of problematic interactions. Not recommended for use in pregnancy or breast-feeding. Use with extreme caution in those with bipolar disorder, prior psychotic episode, unstable panic disorder, lower end blood pressure, kidney or liver issues, or those with a currently-high likelihood of relapsing in addictions.
items.my_version: Do not combine agmatine casually with opioids, kratom, clonidine/guanfacine, blood-pressure medication, nitrates, PDE-5 inhibitors, MAOIs, or complex psychiatric medication stacks without clinician review. Avoid it during pregnancy or breastfeeding, and be especially cautious with bipolar disorder, psychosis history, unstable panic, low blood pressure, kidney/liver disease, or active substance relapse risk.
